title: Actionable obligation record
description: One concrete duty a company can act on: a threshold that switches an obligation on, a deadline, a filing duty, an exemption, or a penalty. Every record carries a verbatim quote that scripts/verify_quotes.py checks against the archived source text — a paraphrased quote fails the build.

kind.description: what sort of duty this is; drives the compliance-calendar view

why_actionable.description: what a compliance officer does differently knowing this

status.description: draft_for_comment must never be presented as a binding duty

topic.description: cross_border | audit | ai | minors | enforcement | financial | platform | biometrics | general

source_id.description: archived source id; must exist in sources/MANIFEST.json with ok=true

conflict_note.description: required when a figure has been superseded or sources disagree
